parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of a laptop, typically made of aluminum alloy for durability and lightweight design. It includes the display panel and bezel.
parts.Functional_description: It displays visual output from the computer, including text, images, and videos. It also houses the webcam and sensors in some models.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to open or close the laptop, typically up to 180 degrees.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy, containing the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components such as the motherboard and battery.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main body of the laptop, housing input devices and internal hardware. It provides structural support and user interaction surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but supports the hinge mechanism for the screen.

parts.name: Connector
parts.Basic_description: This is the connector or hinge part of the laptop, typically made of stainless steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the screen side and base side, allowing smooth rotation and maintaining electrical connections between the two parts.
parts.Movement_description: It allows rotational movement of the screen relative to the base, enabling the laptop to open and close.
